ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Letter sound knowledge, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Letter sound knowledge.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Letter sound knowledge.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Letter sound knowledge.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Letter sound knowledge.

2. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only a joining word
   C. Only an action
   D. Only a describing word

3. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.

4. When practising Language structures School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language structures School.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Language structures School.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language structures School.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language structures School.

5. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library?
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the Library
   D. Where is the library

6. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.

7. When practising Pre-reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Pre-reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Pre-reading.

8. When practising Pronunciation and Vocabulary, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

9. When practising Connected text reading and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Connected text reading and fluency.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text reading and fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Connected text reading and fluency.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text reading and fluency.

10. When practising Word reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Word reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Word reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Word reading.

11. When practising Pre- Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre- Writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Pre- Writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Pre- Writing.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Pre- Writing.

12. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Only one word repeated
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. No full stops
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

13. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. quickly
   C. run
   D. happiness

14. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. went
   C. goed
   D. goes

15. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Pre- Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Spelling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
